Description: MySQL tinyint(1) columns holding integer status codes (-1; 2; 3) rejected by PostgreSQL BOOLEAN
Root Cause / Analysis: MySQL lacks native boolean and uses tinyint(1) for both flags and multi-state enums
Resolution / Workaround: Mapped tinyint columns to SMALLINT/INTEGER in PostgreSQL schema

Description: MySQL CHAR(0) columns in tally_purchase/tally_p_return rejected by PostgreSQL
Resolution / Workaround: Mapped CHAR(0) columns to TEXT in PostgreSQL DDL

Description: Unindexed foreign key joins in multi-table billing views causing query queueing
Root Cause / Analysis: PostgreSQL default table creation only indexes primary keys
Resolution / Workaround: Created composite indexes on PatientBillId; EncounterId; PatientId; ReferenceValueCodeId

Description: External bidirectional analyzer hardware unavailable in isolated pilot sandbox
Root Cause / Analysis: Physical RS232 / TCP LIS analyzers cannot connect to offline sandbox
Resolution / Workaround: Automated mock LIS data engine used for result verification; real device test pending on-site integration

Description: CSSD screen routes referenced in navigation but absent in source codebase
Root Cause / Analysis: CSSD was a future placeholder in source MySQL project and never implemented
Resolution / Workaround: Classified as ABSENT_IN_SOURCE without inventing synthetic workflows

Description: Cashier Duplicate Payment Replay Defect: Missing Idempotency Key & Replay Protection on Payment API
Root Cause / Analysis: Legacy MySQL Express API lacked idempotency keys allowing duplicate cashier receipt creation on rapid click/retry
Resolution / Workaround: Implemented persistent idempotency_records table with SHA-256 payload fingerprinting and atomic ON CONFLICT deduplication in HimsPatientPaymentDetailsBo

Description: Optional financial fields (TDSAmount; AgreementDiscountAmt; Disallowance) undefined during partial cashier collection
Root Cause / Analysis: JavaScript undefined property access during balance subtraction in HimsPatientPaymentDetailsBo
Resolution / Workaround: Added null-safe fallback (|| 0) across payment and refund business objects
